contract: A text parameter matching the enum column makes NULLIF return SQL NULL; a non-matching label returns the original enum value.
A SQL NULL parameter leaves the enum value unchanged under NULLIF semantics.
pg_typeof($1) and pg_typeof(NULLIF(state, $1)) both report the native custom enum type for text and SQL NULL inputs.
An invalid text label reaches PostgreSQL enum input validation and returns SQLSTATE 22P02.
Source rows and native enum values remain unchanged.

native_contract.command: rtk proxy cargo test --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration enum_parameter_context_contract::value_contract_enum_parameters_in_coalesce_array_append_and_nullif -- --include-ignored --exact --nocapture --test-threads=1

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --manifest-path linux/Cargo.toml -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Other direct expression contexts, additional session/search_path configurations and other custom/native cases remain open; the raw domain-over-enum NULLIF refusal and qualified base-enum control are recorded separately.
